applicant.name: Dr. Sophie Lechner
applicant.organisation: Danube Institute for Diabetes Research (university research group)

request.purpose: Policy-making: planning hospital capacity and care pathways for the coming years.
request.question: How many patients with type 2 diabetes have poor glycaemic control, per hospital?
definitions: Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) per patient.
Poor control = latest HbA1c of 8.0 or higher.
Report per hospital: patients with type 2 diabetes who have a HbA1c value, how many of them have poor control and that share in %, one decimal.
